title: Grim Reaper with Cosmic Lotus
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a black hooded robe and white scarf stands on a dark circular platform scattered with film strips, rose petals, and film reels. He holds a glowing pink lotus flower emitting light rings while a large ornate golden picture frame floats above, connected by chains, set against a swirling cosmic sky filled with nebulae, stars, and numerous floating eyeballs.
prompt: A tall skeletal Grim Reaper wearing a flowing black hooded robe and white scarf stands on a dark platform covered in film strips and rose petals. He holds a glowing pink lotus flower that emits rings of light. Above him floats a large ornate golden picture frame connected by chains, containing a smaller scene. The background is a swirling cosmic vortex with nebulae, stars, and dozens of floating eyeballs watching from the sky.
